c10ud_b3rry3.0: Edmund "Smokes" Rry stepped off the supply cart at S-F9 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
One of the first hundred, Edmund "Smokes" Rry was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry dreamt of missing a train. Waking up here seemed an unreasonable punishment for it. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Edmund "Smokes" Rry shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Edmund "Smokes" Rry offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry fired at a movement across the wire at S-F9. The man went down: Emil Galvanooooo, grazed.
hellcat34106: They issued Tobias Hellcat a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Tobias Hellcat fired at a movement across the wire at S-F15. The man went down: Benedikt Jakubwilkuu, grazed. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Tobias Hellcat stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Tobias Hellcat borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord spotted Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Calvary Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.
landon59504: By the time Felix Landon reached R-F17, the war was 2 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Felix Landon watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Felix Landon raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix Landon is whole again, or near enough for the line.
malakaicripps: Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp stepped off the supply cart at R-F7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp asked to leave the stretcher bearers and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A flare caught Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
